title: object-fit as a picture frame
label: A mitred picture frame with stepped moulding and a white mat on a ruled drafting board. The landscape print in its square window is scaled by cover, contain or fill; the strips beside the frame are what cover crops.
caption: The window is the element's box. Cover scales the 2400 × 1500 print to 0.67 so it fills the window and crops 300 px from each side; contain scales it to 0.42 and letterboxes it; fill stretches it to fit and crops nothing.
